scope: Brightness page using existing XML templates; no automatic sensor service or device operations
decisions: Automatic mode hides the entire custom-brightness entry
Manual 10..100 percent value remains separate and is retained
Disabling automatic mode or sensor failure must restore manual value; failure behavior remains future service work
Repeated pages use existing templates and common event handling; no standalone XML is required for each settings subpage
implementation: Existing screen_settings_list and settings_choice; switch extracted from settings_row with unchanged API, style and default hidden state
Shared long_press_row handles both row and switch click paths
Optional cache/command port only; Product does not bind a provider and automatic remains unavailable
No settings format, sensor sampling, timer, worker, flashlight, AOD, DIM or endurance policy change

source_inspection.independent_read_only_review: No remaining definite blocker after corrections and template reuse review

host.build_command: cmake --build artifacts/host/brightness-page-debug --target settings_ui ui_apps ui_shell_lifecycle aod_ui endurance_ui -j 4
covers: Real LVGL pointer row/switch clicks each send one request
Absent provider disabled; rejected row/switch request rolls UI back
Accepted but unapplied mode remains truthful until snapshot refresh
Entry hiding, direct route guard, page recreation and manual value retention
Existing settings switches, AOD, endurance, navigation and shell lifecycle

renders.source: Real host LVGL 9.4.0 snapshots with sample clock; left manual / right automatic with host-only provider

editor.source: Official GUI Export Code and Recompile; no hand-written generated C
editor.limitation: Independent page candidate was superseded by shared screen_settings_list; final complete page is verified by host snapshots, editor previews shared templates

compilation.note: UI Demo is compiled for shared resources; its legacy settings entry is not migrated to the Product settings UI

source_document.identity: Lite-On attributed Appendix A, Rev1.0 22 Feb 2013, explicitly LTR-303ALS / LTR-329ALS; third-party mirror
source_document.limitation: No authenticated original distribution chain, 50ms not tabulated, PFactor text unresolved, board window transmission and absolute lux accuracy unmeasured; no conversion implemented

failures_and_supersession: Initial official compilation succeeded but preview became blank with No draw buffer; Close Project remained loading; normal application exit/reopen recovered it. Cause unknown. Logs retained.
Native automation minimized-window/external-input state was recovered by resetting only the JS control session and reselecting the returned editor window.
Initial standalone-page and intermediate component-reuse candidates were superseded by final shared page template; prior build/test/export logs retained.
Original read-only review raised two incorrect blockers, then retracted them after checking Product refresh and real pointer paths. Final review found none.
Existing SDK FinSH and linker syscall/entry/RWX/DFU warnings retained; no host compile warning in final affected build
Official settings_switch_gen.c retains a blank EOF line; default git diff --check reports only it, and the check excluding blank-at-eof passes

hardware.boundary: Previous LTR hardware round remains separate; no new touch, light-response, physical sleep, current, capacity or battery-life verification

remaining: Automatic brightness sensor scheduling, conversion, mapping, smoothing/hysteresis, preferences and fault fallback belong to the next bounded feature round
Exact final BIN device verification not performed
